title: An artificial embodied world modeler might be conscious

statements.text: IWMT is agnostic about whether an artificial system with autoencoding hierarchies and graph-structured latent spaces would be conscious, but leans toward IIT on practical realization, possibly needing specialized hardware. Built as the controller of an embodied agent, such a system might have phenomenal consciousness. A von Neumann AI is rated probably capable of consciousness.

sources.quote: IWMT is agnostic on this issue, yet may side with IIT in terms of matters of practical realization.
IWMT, however, suggests that artificial thalamocortical systems are likely required for realizing such conscious machines
